title: Measures of maximal entropy for meromorphic maps on compact Kähler manifolds
summary: Let $f$ be a dominant meromorphic self-map of a compact Kähler manifold. Assume that $f$ has a strictly dominant intermediate dynamical degree $λ$ and that the number of isolated $n$-periodic points, counted with multiplicity, is at most $λ^n+o(λ^n)$. Then $f$ admits at most one adapted invariant probability measure of entropy $\logλ$. If such a measure exists, its natural extension is Bernoulli, and the isolated periodic points equidistribute towards it when counted with or without multiplicity.
